author: Alena Gorb, with Sam Illingworth
basis: First-person demonstration and proposed constraint exercise
reported_outcomes: Gorb reports recognizing tension between a newsletter ambition and expectations of success.
proposed_outcomes: Move from generating options to examining reasons for commitment.
limits: Discomfort is not truth and may indicate an unsuitable question.
The model’s claim about needing external validation is an interpretation, not a diagnosis.
A fixed six-month refusal to pivot is not established good practice; the article’s universal cowardice and cognition claims are excluded.
review_note: Merge as a commitment-question variant; retain the useful request to define success concretely and reject psychological certainty.
coverage: Close-read all 142 lines of available extracted article text; image-only content and linked media not reviewed.
